full_judgment:
MUSTAFA KAMAL J : This petition for leave is from the judgment and order dated 28-7-93 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Revision No. 578 of 1993 discharging the Rule and further directing the accused-petitioner to surrender and refusing to modify the condition of bail of the accused petitioner passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Dhaka in Miscellaneous Case No. 651 of 1993 arising out of petition Case No. 382 a/92 under section 109/111 of the Banking Companies Act. 1991 (Act No. XIV of 1991) 

 2. Complainant respondent No. 2 filed a petition of complaint in the Court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka alleging that the accused-petitioner along with 19 other directors of a non-banking private sector financial institution, namely, Bangladesh Commerce and Investment Ltd. (BCI Ltd) in violation of clause (4) of the Non-Banking Financial Order, 1989 carried on banking business committing an offence under section 109 of the said Act and Article 56 of P. 0. No. 127 of 1972. The said company also advanced a huge loan of Tk. 18,78,00,000/- to the said directors and their relations which is also an offence. Cognizance was taken by the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka on 28-4-92 and warrants of arrest were issued against 20 accused-persons including the petitioner-director of BCI Ltd. The petitioner was arrested on 13-8-92 and on 22-2-93 the learned Sessions Judge, Dhaka in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2196 of 1992 granted bail to the accused-petitioner upto 31-3-93 on condition inter alia that by that date he would deposit in the Bangladesh Bank the entire sum of money sanctioned in favour of different business organisations at his instance in proof whereof he would file within the date fixed a certificate from the Bangladesh Bank showing adjustment of the loan amount, failing which, he would be taken into custody. The said period was extended upto 29-6-93. The accused-petitioner, however, in the meanwhile filed Criminal Revision No. 578 of 1993 in the High Court Division challenging the imposition of the above conditions while granting bail to the accused-petitioner.
